create_HistGradientBoostingRegressor_unc: create an unconstrained HistGradientBoostingRegressor model and fit it on feature-target data
create_HistGradientBoostingRegressor_mon: create a HistGradientBoostingRegressor with monotonic increase and decrease constraints and fit it
create_HistGradientBoostingRegressor_fea: create a HistGradientBoostingRegressor with dictionary-based monotonic constraints keyed by feature names
run_PartialDependenceDisplay_from_estima: run PartialDependenceDisplay.from_estimator to plot partial dependence for constrained and unconstrained models
test_HistGradientBoostingRegressor_predi: test that predictions from dictionary-constrained and list-constrained HistGradientBoostingRegressor models are equivalent
